responsibility: This installed runtime header exposes the non-NEON AArch64 ACLE intrinsic interface to user code. It defines inline wrappers, macros, and target-option regions for scalar architectural intrinsics such as bit operations, byte swaps, CRC, JCVT, FP rounding, transactional memory, RNG, and memory tagging, while using #pragma GCC aarch64 hooks and backend builtins to map the source-level ACLE API onto the corresponding AArch64 instructions and feature-specific builtins.
